an10.143:1.1: CXLIII. Dukkhudrayañ ca vo bhikkhave dhammaṃ desissāmi sukhudrayañ ca, taṃ suṇātha . . . pe . . . Katamo ca bhikkhave dukkhudrayo dhammo? Micchādiṭṭhi . . . pe . . . micchāvimutti. Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave dukkhudrayo dhammo. Katamo ca bhikkhave sukhudrayo dhammo? Sammādiṭṭhi . . . pe . . . sammāvimutti. Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sukhudrayo dhammo ti.
